data.title: 庄方宜 · 书店门口把书签送你
data.description: 两人逛完书店，庄方宜在门口回身，把刚挑的叶形书签递向你。另一只手抱着两本新书，绿色宽裤垂到靴边；她略微抿嘴，像是担心你发现她早就选好了这份小礼物。
data.action: 一手抱书，一手递出叶形书签并看你
data.mood: 含蓄的心意与轻微羞涩
data.promptProse: At the bookstore entrance, Zhuang Fangyi turns back and offers a leaf-shaped bookmark, holding two new books against her other arm. Her green original trousers fall to her black boots in the eye-level cowboy view, and her restrained smile suggests a carefully chosen gift. Afternoon daylight touches the bookmark and book spines; the entrance frame shades her dark waist harness as shelves continue inside behind her.
